response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and paradigms, including C/C++ (e.g., National Instruments, LabWindows/CVI), but his recent work has been primarily in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang. While he demonstrates strong problem-solving, architectural, and collaborative skills, his lack of recent C++-focused roles and limited exposure to industrial automation, cloud platforms, or IEC 62443 standards raises concerns about his fit for this specific role. His diverse background is impressive but may not align closely enough with the high-performance, security-critical, and industrial automation requirements of the position.
strengths: Strong C++ experience (e.g., National Instruments, LabWindows/CVI) with a focus on performance and embedded systems
Demonstrated ability to architect scalable, event-driven systems (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz)
Proven track record in agile methodologies, TDD, and collaborative development practices
concerns: Limited recent C++ development (last C++ role in 2015), with primary focus on JavaScript/TypeScript and D-lang in recent years
No explicit mention of industrial automation, cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), or cloud platforms like Azure
Lacks experience with industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA) or secure development lifecycle practices per IEC 62443-4-1

key_factors.factor: Cloud platform or industrial protocol knowledge
